            continue
        equation = [Fraction(0) for _ in range(N)]

        for j in adj_list[i]:
            equation[j] += Fraction(1, len(adj_list[i]))
        equations.append(equation)
    
    # Solve the system of linear equations

    # The expected time to exit from clearing 0
